title: A unit-oriented rectifiable representation has null carrier where the current vanishes
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U, W ⊆ ℝ^P with W open and W ⊆ U. Let T ∈ D_n(U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) vanish on W (T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W). Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Hⁿ-null-measurable (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), θ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ > 0 on M and θ Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ W, and ξ : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) n a.e.-strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M with ‖ξ(x)‖ = 1 (operator norm) for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x. If T(ω) = τ(M, θ, ξ)(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U), then Hⁿ(M ∩ W) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ W) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ‖ξ x‖ = 1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ W) = 0
